name: Arenas de San Pedro (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arenas de San Pedro (a castle with the motto SIEMPRE INCENDIADA Y SIEMPRE FIEL).
history: The flag was approved simultaneously with the blazon of the arms (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 282 of 25 November 1994), described as a square flag of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Arenas de San Pedro arms — castle with motto
